description:
LIVE smart-money feed for Solana meme trading — one payload for a polling loop. Designed to sit inside your trading decision loop (call every ~60s): fresh pump ignitions with SOL flow and unique-wallet counts, a per-alert decision (WATCH_ENTER / EXIT_IF_LONG / STAND_ASIDE), smart-buyer profiles (winrate / smart_score) and the top active whales right now. REST: GET /api/v1/alpha/smart-money ($0.02). Not investment advice.

Args:
    minutes: alert lookback window (5-720)
    limit: max alerts in the feed (1-50)
name: get_smart_money_feed
title: Smart money feed
